implementation.before: Files Rich preview spells twelve existing custom-property bindings as arbitrary compiled class recipes.
implementation.after: Two named compiled utilities retain the same eleven prose bindings and inherited scroll-fade binding, including existing cascade precedence. Both versions already use compiled CSS.
implementation.compiledContract: Independent actual app/library proof covers12bindings in32cascade scenarios, including host overrides, nested roots, prose-invert and more-specific links/alerts. Font sizes and API/state logic are unchanged.

Add Models Moonshot keyless chooser; select all enables Add and clearing disables Add. No model validation, completion or bulk-profile creation.
before.files: Actual owned Markdown bytes served from real workspace via an idle offline conversation, zero messages and no model calls. Rich/Plain toggle, prose-invert in dark themes, semantic descendant colors, native horizontal table scrolling and inherited fade.
before.phone: 390x844 actual settings forms and dedicated /panel route. Initial file-tree-open narrow preview excluded from publication in favor of follow-up native Hide file tree captures. No phone layout change claimed.
before.media: Original PNG/MP4 retained;25fps normal action timing, no speed or pixel-identity claim. Recorder trims still lead-in and adds final hold.

after.production: Real production Local Canvas, Agent Server1.58.1, automation1.25.1, --mars-web, installed Google Chrome in owned private profile. No route interception, DOM mutation, frontend mocks or source edits.
after.files: Actual owned Markdown bytes served from real workspace via an idle offline conversation, zero messages and no model calls. Rich/Plain toggle, prose-invert in dark themes, semantic descendant colors, native horizontal table scrolling and inherited fade.
after.phone: 390x844 dedicated /panel route with native Hide file tree for a readable full-width preview. Supplemental exact-baseline run provides the three matching phone originals. No phone layout change claimed.
after.media: Original PNG/MP4 retained;25fps normal action timing, no speed or pixel-identity claim. Recorder trims still lead-in and adds final hold.

scope.mainFilm: Genuine standalone Local UI, selected observed paths only; actual source crops follow full viewport context.
scope.supplementalBeforePhone: Separate same-baseline run supplies three readable phone originals after native Hide file tree.

comparisonSummary: 11 matched computed state sets, all equal within the documented measured contract; 2 unpaired states explicitly disclosed. No global pixel identity or performance claim.
limits: Appearance-preserving refactor. Native captures compare the specified exact source revisions and named observed paths, without global pixel identity, exhaustive UI coverage or performance claims.
Both Before and After styles are compiled CSS; no inline-style migration is claimed.

Selected complete originals retain existing timing and bytes. The recorder caps still lead-in and holds its final frame; source clock/misses are preserved. Editorial still holds and actual crops are explicitly labelled, with full context before detail.
Five built-in themes have representative stills, plus390×844 phone views; no claim of every state/theme/viewport combination.
No model prompt, completion or agent turn was run. No real provider credential, paid resource, webhook delivery or automation dispatch was used.
Library/host CSS contracts are compiled evidence; live capture uses standalone Local Canvas only.

Files uses a genuine API-created idle conversation with zero messages. Ordinary backend filesystem reads, including the existing Bash adapter, serve owned Markdown bytes; this is distinct from an agent turn or model execution.
Rich/Plain, desktop descendant styling, native wide-table overflow/fade and five themes are observed. Sanitized/absent Markdown tags such as semantic captions are compiled-contract coverage only.

Before phone images come from a separate supplemental run of the exact same baseline commit and served build. The native Hide file tree control makes the preview readable on BOTH revisions; no phone layout fix is claimed.

The two readable phone Rich/table states lack paired baseline computed measurements. Their matched authentic stills are visual smoke; do not infer a phone computed-style pass from the11 desktop state pairs.
Workspace paths, conversation identifiers and ages differ across genuine runs and remain in authentic original captures.
